strings.name: Stevie Wonder
strings.summary: Blind from infancy, Wonder joined Motown as a child and developed from harmonica and singing into multi-instrumental performance, composition and production. His 1970s albums combined soul, funk and electronics while he sought creative control. He supported civil rights, the King holiday and disability equality. His musical activity continued with archival releases in 2026.
